definitionZh: Unicode-bidi CSS 属性,连同方向属性,决定文档中双向文本的处理方式. 例如,如果一个块的内容既包含左对右文本,也包含右对左文本,则用户代理使用复杂的Unicode算法来决定如何显示文本. unicode-bidi属性凌驾于此算法,允许开发者控制文本嵌入.
sourceDefinition: The unicode-bidi CSS property, together with the direction property, determines how bidirectional text in a document is handled. For example, if a block of content contains both left-to-right and right-to-left text, the user-agent uses a complex Unicode algorithm to decide how to display the text. The unicode-bidi property overrides this algorithm and allows the developer to control the text embedding.
